jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Position Summary: CVS Health is on a mission to make health care more convenient, accessible, and affordable for all Americans. We’re looking for a creative writer who can turn data-driven insights into polished, executive-level storytelling and wants to join our team as our next Senior Manager of Executive Communications. This is a high-visibility role, where you’ll become a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders and advance an executive communication strategy that enhances CVS Health’s reputation, supports our business objectives, and builds positive relationships. You’ll partner with and report to the Director of Communications for our EVP, Ventures and Chief Experience and Technology Officer and the Ventures, Experience and Technology organization. The Senior Manager will maintain a bird’s eye view of our technology executive visibility and dive deep into the org for data and insights that bring our innovations to life. The triple-threat candidate is a strong writer whose default is positive energy, an inclination to swing big and move quickly, and organizational skills that are sharp. Key Responsibilities: If you like the stability of a large organization but write like you work at a buzzy start-up, this may be the job for you. You’ll be working alongside senior leaders who prefer a decidedly non-corporate, human tone of voice (i.e. it does not sound like AI wrote it. Ironic, right?). And you won’t be writing puff pieces. This job is great for someone who wants to peel back the layers of a big organization to find stories worth telling. This is a high-visibility role where you’ll often be in rooms (virtual and in-person) with senior executives who are building big things. Polish and executive presence are a must. This person needs to love organization like it’s their job — because it will be. You’ll help keep track of executive speaking engagements across a 12,000-person technology organization. You pride yourself on a mastery of AP Style and review talking points, decks, newsletters, and more to make sure everything is accurate, crisp, and consistent with enterprise guidelines. You make yourself available as your communications peers look to you for technology messaging guidance — and you’ll bring the kind of generous, sharp-eyed perspective that makes the whole team better. You are a doer. Period. You’ll own complex initiatives from kickoff to delivery, keeping competing priorities in check and senior stakeholders aligned. What Success Looks Like: Excellent writing skills. Not “good for a corporate writer” — actually good. You’re comfortable around senior executives and count executive presence among your strengths. Deadlines don’t rattle you. Neither do last-minute pivots or redlined drafts. You’ve delivered under pressure and kind of thrive on it. You make friends easily and you make things happen through those friendships. Across the org, people trust you — and that trust gets things done. You don’t wait to be managed. You’re the one building the timeline, tracking the dependencies, and sending the reminder emails. You understand that every press release, every talking point, every newsletter exists inside a bigger story — and you know how to make sure they all tell it well. Required Qualifications 7+ years of editorial/communication experience in a large organization, media company, newsroom, or agency. Education A Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, English, Marketing, PR, or something adjacent preferred — though if you’ve spent years doing the work and have the portfolio to prove it, we’re listening. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program. Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong. Great benefits for great people We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families. Hangar 13 is looking for a seasoned Senior Rendering Engineer who enjoys a collaborative and creative work environment and is looking to push the boundaries of cutting-edge 3D graphics. In this role, you will bridge the gap between stock Unreal Engine 5 capabilities and the high-performance, photorealistic visual demands of our current AAA projects. Working in a globally distributed team alongside our Tech Art, Lighting, and Environment teams, you will research, implement, and optimize custom rendering techniques that empower artists to deliver their vision stably and performantly. This is an ideal position for an engineer who thrives on navigating large codebases, solving complex technical pipeline overlaps, and making bold engine-level changes to advance game technology.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Advance, modify, and optimize Unreal Engine 5's stock rendering pipeline to meet strict performance and artistic demands.
• Partner closely with the Lighting Team, Environment Art teams, and Tech Art/Shaders departments to bridge team overlaps, eliminate pipeline bottlenecks, and bring the creative vision of our games to life.
• Research, develop, implement, and debug high-end, photorealistic graphics techniques applicable to characters and large-scale environments.
• Efficiently draft and deliver clear technical designs to different audiences, skillfully filtering out unnecessary detail for non-technical stakeholders.
• Identify technical and developmental risks/obstacles within the rendering pipeline and proactively generate solutions to overcome them.
• Navigate, maintain, and safely improve within a massive, multi-platform codebase using advanced C++ and modern graphics APIs.
• Collaborate closely across multiple studio locations, ensuring close alignment with the Render Lead and local engineering anchors between studio locations.

Essential Skills, Attributes and Experience

• Industry Experience: Significant experience in computer games engineering, specifically focused on real-time computer graphics, shaders, and engine development.
• Technical Mastery: Advanced knowledge of C++ and multi-threaded programming techniques.
• Graphics: Strong knowledge of modern Real-Time Rendering techniques, 3D math, and linear algebra.
• Language & Communication: English proficiency with exceptional communication and collaboration skills.
• Work Style: Demonstrated ability to work both collaboratively within a highly integrated global team and self-sufficiently as an outcome-oriented problem solver.

• Shipped Titles: Shipped one or more AAA game titles on multiple platforms.

• 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
• 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
• 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Director, Communications, Central Europe The Director, Communications, Central Europe leads Mastercard's communications strategy across 12 markets within the Central Europe Division. This senior leadership role is responsible for driving a consistent Mastercard narrative while adapting communications to local market priorities, stakeholder environments, and business needs. The Director leads and connects a distributed communications team, including direct reports and colleagues aligned through matrix reporting structures. The role focuses on setting priorities, fostering collaboration, sharing expertise across markets, and ensuring high-quality communications outcomes that support business objectives and strengthen Mastercard's reputation. As a trusted adviser to Central Europe leadership, Country Managers, and senior business stakeholders, the Director translates business priorities into impactful communications strategies while balancing divisional, European, and global priorities. Key responsibilities: Lead Communications Across Central Europe Develop and implement the communications strategy for the Central Europe Division, aligned with Mastercard's business objectives and broader European and global communications priorities. Provide leadership across communications activities in all Central Europe markets, ensuring consistent messaging and effective local execution. Build and lead a high-performing communications community across multiple reporting lines. Coach and develop team members while fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and accountability. Prioritize resources and investments to maximize business impact. Act as a Strategic Business Partner Serve as a trusted communications adviser to division leadership and Country Managers. Develop a deep understanding of Mastercard's strategy, customers, competitive landscape, and growth priorities. Translate business objectives into communications programs that enhance reputation and support business growth. Provide counsel on emerging trends, opportunities, and reputational risks. Influence stakeholders across local, divisional, regional, and global teams within a complex matrix organization. Build and Protect Mastercard's Reputation Strengthen Mastercard's reputation and positioning across Central Europe. Identify and deliver strategic communications opportunities that support business priorities. Lead executive communications and media engagement activities. Provide guidance on reputational issues, issues management, and crisis communications. Position Mastercard executives as credible external voices on topics relevant to customers, partners, policymakers, and industry stakeholders. Drive Integrated Communications Champion integrated communications across corporate communications, employee communications, public policy, marketing, and business functions. Align Central Europe communications efforts with broader European and global initiatives. Ensure strong planning, execution, measurement, and accountability across markets. Manage agency partnerships, budgets, and resources to deliver maximum value and impact. Promote innovation and continuous improvement across communications activities. Maintain Communications Excellence While primarily a strategic leadership role, the Director is expected to provide hands-on support in high-profile or sensitive situations, including: Executive communications and media relations. Crisis and issues management. Development of key messaging and narratives. Major announcements and business milestones. Ensuring consistently high standards across all communications activities. Experience and Capabilities The successful candidate will be a commercially minded communications leader with significant experience operating in complex international environments. Key qualifications include: Extensive experience in corporate communications within multinational or matrixed organizations. Proven success leading communications across multiple countries or markets. Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing teams through both direct and indirect reporting relationships. Excellent business acumen and ability to align communications strategies with commercial objectives. Strong executive presence and experience advising senior leaders. Expertise in reputation management, media relations, and crisis communications. Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills. Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, complex environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Fluency in German and English. Leadership Profile The ideal candidate: Leads through influence and empowers others to succeed. Balances divisional priorities with local market realities. Creates clarity and alignment within a complex matrix organization. Builds trust and credibility with senior leaders and communications teams. Makes effective decisions and establishes clear priorities. Understands the business drivers behind the communications agenda. Connects local, regional, and global priorities. Fosters a collaborative, high-performing communications culture. Maintains high standards of execution and accountability. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
